messages:
laura_sales: Passing to CS  Lumenix signed today (Enterprise, data analytics). Committed to Dedicated: 6x A100 initially, target scale to 12x if pilot metrics good. Regions: eu-west-1 primary, us-west-2 backup. Exec sponsor: Priya Anand (Head of ML). Go-live target 2024-07-01. Key risks: SAML cert timing, EU egress charges clarity, and prompt hallucinations on noisy telemetry labels. I uploaded the prompt pack and contract addendum to the shared folder. Tagging @kevin_cs and @mike_eng to pick up. :handshake:

kevin_cs: I'll own CSM and weekly status. Thanks Laura. Need billing/legal contacts and the explicit SLA ask. Also will own feedback capture during pilot. Can someone confirm whether they want nightly evals vs weekly?

laura_sales: Billing: finance@lumenix.ai, Legal: contracts@lumenix.ai. SLA ask: pilot-level 99.5% availability; long-term they asked about 99.9% for dedicated. They requested audit log export to their EU S3 and a monthly token-cost forecast. Prompt pack link: https://redwood.share/lumenix/promptset (uploaded).

anya_csm: Day-to-day CSM here. I'll schedule kickoff for week of 6/24 and run enablement. Enablement asks: 1) Eng to do a 30m session on SAML test flow + fallback policy 2) SE to present cost per 1k tokens and batching tips 3) Product to capture top-10 failure cases during week 1. @mike_eng @oli_se

mike_eng: I'll triage ENG-6888 for SAML and ENG-6889 for EU peering. ETA initial triage 48h. Need SAML metadata XML, SP entityID, cert expiry, and network contact for peering. We can join kickoff and demo SSO test with a sandbox user. For fallbacks: recommended auto-fallback to redwood-v1-7b when pool exhausted.

ticket_bot: Created tickets CS-8123 "Lumenix EU peering - network details needed" and ENG-6888 "Lumenix SAML integration - triage". Links: https://redwood.atlassian.net/browse/CS-8123 https://redwood.atlassian.net/browse/ENG-6888

oli_se: I'll own runbook + cost spreadsheet. Draft checklist highlights: 1) Confirm VPC peering CIDRs & firewall rules 2) SAML metadata + test user 3) Model pin (redwood-v2-13b-quant) & quant profile 4) Eval harness + 50 labeled examples 5) Audit log export to EU S3. Quick provisioning snippet:

```
# provisioning vars for Lumenix
CUSTOMER=lumenix
POOL_MIN=6
POOL_TARGET=12
MODEL=redwood-v2-13b-quant
REGION=eu-west-1
VPC_PEER=true
```

oli_se: Cost note: estimate baseline token cost once we have avg tokens/request and rps. I'll share sheet by EOD tomorrow and include a best/worst case.

anya_csm: Quality guardrails: capture top-10 prompt failures and label 50 GT examples before pilot start. We'll run nightly evals and set an alert if pass rate < 95% for extraction tasks. Who will own the labels? Product or Customer?

laura_sales: Customer offered to provide 30 labeled examples to speed onboarding; Product team to supplement to 50. I'll coordinate.

mike_eng: For onboarding ops: recommend enabling prefix caching for recurring system prompts to lower cost and KV cache sizing based on 5k token context typical for their queries. Also we can add an automatic rollback policy if regression detected during nightly evals.

kevin_cs: Action items (draft): 1) Laura to confirm legal/billing contacts and upload prompt set (DONE) 2) Ticket_bot tickets CS-8123 / ENG-6888 active 3) Mike to triage SAML/peering (ETA 48h) 4) Oli to share runbook + cost sheet by EOD tomorrow 5) Anya to schedule kickoff week of 6/24 and own feedback capture 6) Laura to coordinate labeled examples (30 from customer + 20 from product). I'll track weekly and flag renewal-risk if pilot metrics drift. Any other owners or issues? :eyes:
